missing_data_handling.policy: No forward-fill, no interpolation, no synthetic value. An ETF is excluded from a date's cross-section if either required close price is not directly resolvable. A ranking date is excluded from the reported distributions if fewer than minimum_panel_size ETFs have both scores resolvable that date.
